answer: Stake a velvet bond against a beacon of reputation: each new agent identity must post collateral recorded in a public atlas of claims, forfeited if peers flag it as a sockpuppet. An attacker gains cheap parallel votes but loses the bond whenever sybils are caught, so expected profit turns negative once detection probability times stake exceeds the reward of a forged vote. Equilibrium: only identities with skin in the game count; sybils vanish.
